name: ui-tap
prompt: Short crisp UI tap click, like a fingertip tapping a glass tablet button.

name: ui-back
prompt: Soft low-pitched UI back-navigation blip, a gentle descending wooden tick.

name: ui-open
prompt: Light airy UI panel opening swoosh with a small bright chime tail.

name: select-confirm
prompt: Clean bright selection confirm ping, like tapping a small brass bell once.

name: brush-fill
prompt: Wet paintbrush dab pressing onto canvas with a soft bristle thock.

name: drag-fill
prompt: Short paintbrush drag stroke swiping across dry canvas.

name: region-fill
prompt: Broad paint roller wash sweeping across a canvas region, ending with a soft splash.

name: error-buzz
prompt: Low gritty wrong-answer buzzer, a short electric hum with a dull knock.

name: invalid-deny
prompt: Muted denied-action thunk, like a rubber stamp hitting a padded desk.

name: combo-chime
prompt: Ascending cascade of bright crystalline chimes for a combo streak.

name: undo-sweep
prompt: Quick reverse tape-rewind whoosh, a downward sliding swoosh.

name: hint-sparkle
prompt: Delicate magical sparkle of two tiny glass bells for a hint reveal.

name: pause-click
prompt: Gentle mechanical pause click, like a camera shutter half-press.

name: resume-click
prompt: Light uplifting resume click, like a small latch releasing.

name: lesson-step
prompt: Friendly two-note lesson advance chime, soft marimba tones.

name: complete-fanfare
prompt: Triumphant short completion fanfare of rising brass-like tones with a sparkle tail.

name: failed-fall
prompt: Sad descending three-note fall, a muted trombone-like wah.
